issue.title: [BUG] applyTail reports a fractional line count, so the truncation notice disagrees with the lines returned

steps: Use execute_command to run a command that prints 10 lines (e.g. seq 10) with tail set to 2.5, and show me the returned output header.
expected: The truncation notice states the same whole number of lines that is actually returned (or the fractional tail is rejected).
defect: The tool returns `[showing last 2.5 of 10 lines]` followed by only 2 lines, so the notice disagrees with the body.

fault location.explanation: Uses n = Math.abs(tail ?? DEFAULT_TAIL_LINES) both for lines.slice(-n), which truncates 2.5 to 2, and verbatim in the `[showing last ${n} of ...]` notice; PR #23570 (commit 44057ea) wraps it in Math.floor so the notice and the slice agree.
The tail parameter is z.preprocess(coerceNumericString, z.number()) with no integer constraint, so a fractional 2.5 (or "2.5") reaches applyTail; PR #23570 changes it to z.number().int().

Root cause: FIXED UPSTREAM IN https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/23570 (commit 44057eac6fd048100574bf71c6dc095f769a6d63). The execute_command (and get_process_output) input schema accepts tail as any number, and coerceNumericString also turns decimal strings into numbers, so a model-supplied tail of 2.5 reaches applyTail in packages/core/src/workspace/tools/output-helpers.ts unchanged. applyTail uses the same value n for Array.prototype.slice(-n), which truncates 2.5 toward zero and keeps 2 lines, and for the notice `[showing last ${n} of ${lines.length} lines]`, which prints 2.5, so the model is told about an impossible cut. The fix floors n in applyTail (treating |tail| < 1 as no limit) and constrains tail to integers with z.number().int() in execute-command.ts and get-process-output.ts. The fix is first released in mastracode@0.40.0 (@mastra/core@1.67.0); the pinned mastracode@0.41.0 already contains it, so the case is tested at mastracode@0.39.1, the last release before the fix and the latest release when the issue was opened, which provides the ACP entry and still has the faulty code.
